rules.title: 1. Serious & realistic roleplay
rules.body: Stay in character at all times in public. ShadeRP is realistic RP — your character should behave like a real person in Los Santos. No arcade behavior.

rules.title: 2. Respect everyone
rules.body: Treat players and staff with respect. Harassment, slurs, hate speech, discrimination, or toxicity is zero tolerance — instant ban.

rules.title: 3. No RDM / VDM
rules.body: Random deathmatch and vehicle deathmatch are forbidden. You must have proper RP initiation before any hostile action.

rules.title: 4. New Life Rule (NLR)
rules.body: After you die or respawn, you forget the events leading to your death. Do not return to the scene, seek revenge, or pass info to others about that situation.

rules.title: 5. Value your life (Fear RP)
rules.body: If someone has a weapon on you or you are outnumbered, comply. Do not fight unrealistic odds or act like you are invincible.

rules.title: 6. RP initiation & escalation
rules.body: Crime and conflict need clear verbal or text initiation and logical escalation. Give the other party time to respond.

rules.title: 7. No cop baiting
rules.body: Do not intentionally provoke police for a chase or shootout with no RP reason. Criminal activity must make sense for your character.

rules.title: 8. No metagaming
rules.body: Do not use Discord, streams, clips, or OOC info in-character. What your character knows must come from in-game events only.

rules.title: 9. No powergaming / fail RP
rules.body: Do not force outcomes other players cannot respond to. No unrealistic actions (e.g. surviving impossible injuries, ignoring restraints).

rules.title: 10. No cheating or exploits
rules.body: Mod menus, money glitches, duping, bug abuse, or bypassing anticheat (EZAC) is permanent ban territory. Report bugs — do not exploit them.

rules.title: 11. Microphone required
rules.body: A working microphone is required for most RP. Push-to-talk is recommended. Text RP is limited — check Discord for exceptions.

rules.title: 12. Discord first
rules.body: Join discord.gg/sbnu98HYAZ before playing. Read all Discord rules and announcements — they are part of server policy.

rules.title: 13. Staff decisions are final
rules.body: Staff may intervene in scenes to preserve RP quality. Argue respectfully in tickets — not in public chat.

**18 June 2026 · Enhancement Pass v15 — Web queue (LiquidRP-style)**

---

## Overview

Players must **login on the ShadeRP website with Discord**, join the **web queue**, then connect to FiveM when their slot is ready. Staff get a priority queue lane. The server blocks direct connects until the portal verifies your Discord ID.

---

## Website (shaderp-website.onrender.com)

| Feature | Detail |
|---------|--------|
| **Queue page** | Dedicated `/queue` panel — join, position, ETA, ready sound |
| **Home widget** | Join Queue hero button + live queue stats |
| **Connect page** | Queue widget above CFX join link |
| **Server strip** | Players online + queue count |
| **Top bar** | Shows queue position or "Ready to connect" when logged in |

**Portal API:** `/api/queue/join`, `/leave`, `/me`, `/config` — FiveM sync via `QUEUE_API_KEY`

---

## FiveM — shade-queue

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Resource** | `resources/[standalone]/shade-queue/` |
| **Gate** | `playerConnecting` verifies portal before `connectqueue` |
| **Sync** | Posts player count to portal every 30s |
| **Convars** | `shade:queueApiUrl`, `shade:queueApiKey`, `shade:webQueueEnabled` |

Ensure order in `server.cfg`: **`shade-queue` before `connectqueue`**

---

## Setup (required once)

1. Render env: `QUEUE_API_KEY` + `QUEUE_ENABLED=1`
2. `server.cfg`: `set shade:queueApiKey` (same key as Render)
3. Redeploy portal (GitHub push to shaderp-website)
4. Full server restart

Discord must be **linked in FiveM** (Settings → Linked accounts).

---

## Also in this pass

- Portal content FAQ updated with web queue steps
- Changelog rendering fixed on website (tables + typography)
- UTF-8 fix for Discord changelog export

**Post Discord:** `tools/Post-Changelog.ps1 -Version v15`

---
